q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE NAME NOT IN ( SELECT S.NAME FROM SALESPERSON S, COMPANY C, ORDERS O WHERE O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID AND O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
